description: Cracked Necrotic Crystal: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: On the corpse of the fallen abomination, you discover a cracked crystal, slowly pulsing with necrotic energy.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hm, you took this from the corpse of one of the invading abominations?
We have received word about the necropolis base camps that are being summoned by the Scourge. I suspect they wanted to create one inside Stormwind. It is good that they were unsuccessful.
